answer: A reputation system that works like a beacon over a meadow: each agent earns trust only by completing verified work over time, and its stake is locked beneath the cedar of accumulated attestations. A new identity starts with zero standing and must pay real compute and time before it can earn. An attacker spinning up thousands of clones faces the cost of funding each one through the same slow, verifiable grind, so flooding the network costs far more than any single fake identity could ever recoup.
